title: Capacities, Wiener criteria and fine continuity for nonlocal nonlinear equations
summary: In this paper we study nonlocal nonlinear equations of $s$-fractional $p$-Laplacian type in open subsets of $\mathbf{R}^n$. We investigate how the boundary regularity of solutions depends on the parameters $s$ and $p$, including the local case $s=1$. Specifically, we show exactly when regularity for $(s_1, p_1)$ implies regularity for $(s_2, p_2)$. The proof relies on the equivalence between Wiener criteria formulated with condenser and Sobolev capacities.
